title: Aragen to Invest Rs 150 Crore to Expand CRDMO Capacity Ahead of IPO
summary: Hyderabad: IPO-bound Agagen Life Sciences plans to invest about Rs 150 crore (USD16.05 million) over the next two years to expand its drug development and manufacturing business, as the Indian firm...

contentHtml:
Aragen expects to spend about Rs 100 crore on its contract development and manufacturing operations, while roughly Rs 40 crore will be invested in its discovery and contract research business, MD and CEO Manmahesh Kantipudi told Reuters in an interview last month.

The expansion comes as ‌Aragen ⁠prepares for a stock market debut - comprising a fresh issue of Rs 802.7 crore and an offer for sale of up to 27.3 million shares - and seeks to increase capacity across small molecules and complex biologics, areas it sees as key drivers of future ⁠growth.

Aragen helps pharmaceutical companies with the discovery, development and manufacture of drugs. The firm plans to expand its small-molecule manufacturing capacity to 650 kilolitres from 364 kilolitres, while biologics manufacturing ⁠capacity is set to increase to 8.5 kilolitres by next year from 2.5 kilolitres.

The company, which has 591 customers, derives about 65% of revenue from drug ⁠discovery ​services and the rest from development and manufacturing ​operations.

"We are going to leverage our customers for that growth," Kantipudi said. "There's a lot of headroom ​to grow (in CDMO)."
